name: zvideo_dd_present_display_mode_surface
description: zVideo_dd::PresentDisplayModeSurface presents the software/primary surface to the display-mode DirectDraw surface, handles page-lock adjustment state, retries restored lost surfaces, and binds as the non-hardware adjust callback.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw display/mode-management source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a7b60 validates fastcall ECX=srcRect, EDX=dstRect, stack waitForPresent/skipSurfaceStateSwap, null display or primary surface returning 0x400, DirectDraw Blt flags DDBLT_WAIT plus optional DDBLT_ASYNC, PageLock/PageUnlock around half-res adjustment, 32-byte primary/software surface-state swapping through g_zVideo_SurfaceStateSwapScratch, DDERR_SURFACELOST restore-and-retry, and ReportError lines 0x6c, 0x91, and 0xac.

Binary Ninja for zVideo::BindRendererDispatch validates that the adjust-surface dispatch table installs zVideo_dd3d::PresentDisplayModeSurface for hardware renderer type 1 and overwrites it with zVideo_dd::PresentDisplayModeSurface for non-hardware renderer types.

The native smoke verifies half-res and adjusted-page-lock Blt paths, state swapping, skip-swap PageUnlock, DDERR_SURFACELOST restore-and-retry, null-surface result, and the DD versus D3D bind-dispatch selection.
